recipeNotes: Every GET route in the app.js router table that returns non-5xx with the placeholder API keys, then the authenticated write path (signup → session → profile update → logout) which is what reaches mongoose, the bcrypt native binding, connect-mongo sessions and the pug render path.

phases.name: common
phases.detail: public pages + static assets (pug rendering, sass output, express.static)

phases.name: full
phases.detail: the API-integration pages and the authenticated signup/profile/logout flow
